scope: English guidance for an adult securing their own personal Google account or Gmail after suspected unauthorized activity. It selects an official recovery or review route; it does not diagnose compromise, assess financial loss or guarantee account security.

questions.prompt: Is this your own personal Google account, as an adult?

choices.label: It is a work, school or managed account
It is for a child or someone else

questions.help: This guide never asks for an email address, password, recovery code or identity document.

questions.prompt: Can you sign in to the Google account now?
What makes you think someone else may have accessed it?

choices.label: A device I do not recognize
Something else or I am not sure
